data.name: Firdous
data.gender_notes: Firdous is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Firdous refers to a beautiful garden or paradise, often associated with the Islamic concept of Jannah. The name Firdous carries the meaning “Paradise or Heaven” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Firdous usually hope their child will grow to embody paradise or heaven and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Firdous is mentioned as the highest level of paradise, reserved for the righteous.
data.etymology: Firdous belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Paradise or Heaven.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Firdous total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: فردوس
in_arabic.meaning: جنة، أعلى درجة في الجنة، الفردوس الأعلى
in_arabic.long_meaning: فردوس هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الجنة أو أعلى درجة في الجنة، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الكهف الآية 107 'وَمَن يَأْمَن بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِ فَلاَ يَخَافُ وَلاَ يَحْزَنُ * أُوْلَـئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ مَسْكُونَةً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ * هَـذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ لَفَضْلاً * أُوْلَـئِكَ هُمُ الْفُرُوسُ الْأَعْلَى * جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَذَلِكَ جَزَاءُ مَن تَزَكَّى'

in_urdu.name: فردوس
in_urdu.meaning: جنت، اعلیٰ درجہ جنت کا، فردوس اعلیٰ
in_urdu.long_meaning: فردوس ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب جنت یا جنت کا اعلیٰ درجہ ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، سورہ کہف آیت 107، اور یہ نام انبیاء اور صالحین کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو جنت میں اعلیٰ مقام حاصل کرتے ہیں

in_pashto.name: فردوس

in_english.name: Firdous
in_english.long_meaning: Firdous is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots, meaning paradise or the highest degree of heaven, referenced in the Quran, Surah Al-Kahf, verse 107, symbolizing a high rank in paradise for the righteous, and signifying spiritual elevation and divine reward in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Firdous is often given to children as a symbol of beauty, elegance, and royalty. It is a name that evokes the image of an exquisite and delightful garden, reminding us of the sayings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) about paradise being the most beautiful of gardens.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Firdous represents a connection to the divine, a reminder of the eternal gardens of paradise that await us after this life. It is a symbol of hope, joy, and contentment, as the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) describes paradise as a place where there is no sorrow, no fatigue, and no need, and where only the eternal happiness of the soul in the presence of Allah exists. The name Firdous serves as a reminder of the ultimate goal of our existence on this earth - to seek Allah's pleasure and strive for entry into His garden, Jannah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Paradise or Heaven" symbolizes Firdous refers to a beautiful garden or paradise, often associated with the Islamic concept of Jannah.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Firdous serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of paradise or heaven.
